column1: # ArduPilot's STM32H7 clock tree, by OSCILLATOR_HZ (AET-WO-4412 D1 (a)): the kernel clocks unmodified ArduPilot runs
# its timers and USARTs at, which a specification's `mcu.foreign_clock` must equal on an ArduPilot board.
# 67f48e5f34466b6da633a54b3321dac44f7c7d4d6cf6065fad84a7059201a426. Every row's lines are that file's; any other
# oscillator is "#error Unsupported HSE clock" (L164-165). HAL_CUSTOM_MCU_CLOCKRATE unset (the generated hwdef
# emits no MCU_CLOCKRATE_MHZ), so PLL1 N and Q are L194-195 / L221-222.
# Fixed for every row: HSI at 64 MHz (STM32_HSIDIV_DIV1, L104); STM32_SW PLL1_P (L288); D1CPRE /1 (L289), D1HPRE /2
# (L290), D2PPRE1 and D2PPRE2 /2 (L292-293), TIMPRE TRUE (L312), so each APB timer clock equals HCLK (RM0433 Rev 9
# Table 57, pp. 351-352: D2PPRE 100 with TIMPRE 1); USART16SEL and USART234578SEL PLL2_Q (L343-344); VOS Scale 1 (L109).
# Columns, tab-separated: oscillator_hz (0: no crystal, the HSI), pll1_divm, pll1_divn, pll1_divp, pll2_divm, pll2_divn,
